Repository and licence

Software judged for this award has to be on iGEM's GitLab, under an OSI-approved licence. Link it here.

Where the code must live

Teams applying for the Software award must host the source on iGEM's GitLab at gitlab.igem.org/2026/software-tools/. Code on any other host cannot be judged.
